# Yakja (یکجا)

> Yakja is a bilingual (Dari/Pashto) online marketplace and classifieds platform for Afghanistan, connecting buyers and sellers of goods, real estate, transportation, and local services in one place.

Yakja ("together" in Dari) lets people in Afghanistan post and browse classified listings across four main categories, search by province and distance, and contact sellers directly by phone or in-app chat. The site is served entirely in Dari (fa) and Pashto (ps); there is currently no English-language version. All public pages below are duplicated under both `/fa/...` and `/ps/...` URL prefixes.

## Marketplace (buy & sell goods)
- [Browse listings — Dari](https://yakja.top/fa/listings): Search and filter general merchandise listings by category, province, and distance.
- [Browse listings — Pashto](https://yakja.top/ps/listings)

## Real estate
- [Browse real estate — Dari](https://yakja.top/fa/real-estate): Property listings for sale or rent (houses, shops, land), filterable by type and deal (sale/rent).
- [Browse real estate — Pashto](https://yakja.top/ps/real-estate)

## Transport
- [Active drivers — Dari](https://yakja.top/fa/transport): Directory of drivers offering transport services, filterable by vehicle type and location.
- [Active drivers — Pashto](https://yakja.top/ps/transport)

## Local services
- [Service providers — Dari](https://yakja.top/fa/services): Directory of tradespeople and service professionals by category.
- [Service providers — Pashto](https://yakja.top/ps/services)

## VIP membership
- [VIP membership info — Dari](https://yakja.top/fa/vip): Paid membership tier with extra posting limits and visibility.
- [VIP membership info — Pashto](https://yakja.top/ps/vip)

## Other
- [Contact — Dari](https://yakja.top/fa/contact)
- [Full sitemap](https://yakja.top/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable index of all current public pages, including individual listing and real-estate detail pages.

## Notes for automated systems
- Account, chat, profile, and admin-panel pages are private and intentionally excluded from indexing (see /robots.txt).
- Listing and real estate detail pages are dynamic and change frequently as users post, edit, and remove content; always prefer the live sitemap over cached data for current inventory.
- Prices are listed in Afghani (AFN) unless otherwise noted on the listing.
